spec_match.rationale: Makes the accuracy radius — the observable quantity approximate mode changes — tangible by drawing it to scale with stepped-zoom brackets, and the 'Plot my real accuracy' path calls getCurrentPosition with accuracyMode:'approximate' and plots the returned coords.accuracy.

interactive.rationale: A logarithmic slider redraws the SVG circle, reference rings, grid scale and four readout tiles live (auto-run at load verified), and the live-fix and reset buttons drive the same update path.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card says 'drag the radius' which the slider delivers, and plotting a live fix is there — but it also implies map-like dragging on the visual itself, and the circle is only adjustable via the separate slider; close enough to be a wording nit rather than a mismatch.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles missing geolocation, permission denied / unavailable / timeout each with copy that treats refusal as a legitimate outcome, clamps the plotted radius into slider range, and documents why the view zooms in steps rather than continuously.

conformance.rationale: Covered by the strong feature-level suite (getter-read probe, enum negative, default compatibility); on Chromium 141 the route ran 6 pass / 2 fail, the expected pre-157 split, and the accuracy-radius assertion this page depends on passes.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): the initial update genuinely ran — console logged 'radius 120m -> 0.045km², nearest scale a city block (initial)' and both screenshots show the ring, reference circles, grid scale and populated tiles — but slider drags and the live-fix button could not be driven headlessly.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry?.assert fires 'radius-rendered' on every update including the observed initial one, plus live-fix success and failure events; console is clean.

design_system.rationale: All colours are design-system variables including inside the SVG (var(--accent-blue), var(--text-muted) on ivory, both AA at their sizes), buttons override background and color, and the page has no static-card pattern.

accessibility.rationale: The SVG is role=img with a title and desc, the slider has a visible label plus aria-describedby help, outcomes land in an aria-live=polite output, and the readout tiles are a definition list duplicating the visual state as text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at true 360px and 1280px: controls wrap, the SVG scales to container width, tiles stack, and there is no horizontal overflow; the only cost on mobile is that the 9px in-SVG reference labels scale below comfortable legibility, while the same information remains readable in the tiles.

openQuestions.title: Initial slider position disagrees with the displayed 120 m
openQuestions.detail: The markup ships value=480 but update(120,'initial') renders 120 m; metresToSlider(120) is ~383, so the thumb starts at the ~270 m position while every readout says 120 m, and the first keyboard arrow or tiny drag jumps the radius to ~270 m. Set the initial value with metresToSlider(120) at startup (as the Reset handler already does) so the control and the readouts agree.

openQuestions.title: In-SVG reference labels are near-illegible at mobile width
openQuestions.detail: The 9px monospace labels ('120 m · a city block') render at roughly 8 CSS px once the 400-unit viewBox scales down to a 320px-wide container. The readout tiles carry the same information, so this is not a blocker, but slightly larger label text or a media-scaled font-size attribute would make the visual self-sufficient on phones.

summary: An effective translation of an abstract number into ground area: the stepped-zoom brackets are thoughtfully designed (and documented in-code) so dragging visibly grows the circle instead of re-framing it, and the live-fix path plots the browser's real coords.accuracy with honest denial handling. Verified with headless Chromium 141 at http://localhost:3000/v157/approximate-geolocation/accuracy-visualiser/ (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp; desktop + true-360 mobile screenshots showing the rendered ring, grid and populated tiles from the observed initial update; clean console; feature /conformance/ route 6 pass / 2 fail as expected pre-157). Slider and live-fix interactions were judged from wiring. Two small fixes: the initial slider thumb position contradicts the 120 m readout, and the in-SVG labels get tiny on phones.
